_readme: Optional override map: company name (exactly as it appears in your reports) → LinkedIn info. The Reference finder guesses the slug from the name automatically; add an entry only when the guess is wrong (common for short or surname-like company names), or to enable the strict 'current employees only' filter. Copy this file to config/li-companies.json (git-ignored) and edit it. You can also add a company straight from the Reference finder modal in the dashboard.
_how_to_get_slug: Open the company's LinkedIn page; the slug is the part after /company/ in the URL, e.g. linkedin.com/company/spotify → "spotify".
_how_to_get_id: On LinkedIn people search, apply the 'Current company' filter for that company, then read the number in the URL: ...currentCompany=["1234567"]... → id "1234567". With an id set, the first link on each card becomes a strict current-employees-only filter.
